q1.q: How fast is hospital bed delivery?
q1.a: We commit to delivery within 24 hours anywhere in Malaysia once the order is confirmed. In Klang Valley and major cities, same-day delivery is usually possible.

q2.q: How does the monthly rental work?
q2.a: Flexible monthly rental — one month minimum, extend anytime. Pay the deposit and first month to start, and we collect the bed when your rental ends.

q3.a: Yes. Our team assembles the bed, fits the mattress, and walks you through the remote or air pump at no extra charge — including upstairs delivery if needed.

q4.a: We accept online bank transfer, DuitNow, and credit cards. The payment link is sent to your WhatsApp once you confirm the order.

q5.q: Is there a warranty on purchases?
q5.a: Yes. Every purchase comes with an official warranty — typically 1 year for electric beds and 6 months for air mattresses. We also handle the warranty claim process for you.

q6.q: Should I pick manual or electric?
q6.a: Manual beds are cheaper and suit patients who can still move a little. Electric beds suit long-term bedridden patients or elderly carers — one-button adjustment makes daily care much easier.

q7.q: Which mattress fits the hospital bed?
q7.a: Our foam and air mattresses are all standard hospital-bed size (90×190 cm), so any of our mattresses fits any of our beds.

q8.q: Can I return the items after rental?
q8.a: Yes. We collect the bed, mattress, and accessories from your home at no extra charge once the rental period ends. All equipment is cleaned and serviced before its next use.

q9.q: Are these hospital-grade or home-grade beds?
q9.a: All our beds are hospital-grade — steel frame, side rails, locking wheels — but designed to feel comfortable in a normal family home.

q10.a: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp anytime for technical help, replacement parts, or equipment care tips. Our team handles requests throughout your rental or warranty period.
